done_when: A failed close's output ends with the full list of failed test files and test names and the path of the full test log

known.title: Follow-up: Include Vitest and Jest failures in the footer

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 3, Harm 1
Case: normal use - close runs a supported Vitest or Jest suite with many failures. The footer reads only the results file populated by the pytest hook (`review.py:480–484`). Native Node runners execute without writing that file (`fasttest.py:273–286`), so their footer says test names are unavailable; earlier failure names remain lost outside the bounded output tail. All three new proof cases run pytest, leaving this supported runner case uncovered.
findings.title: Follow-up: Include Vitest and Jest failures in the footer

why: A failed close prints only a bounded tail of the test output, so people rerun whole suites to find which tests failed
